applies_why: The judge text issues a HELD result of DEFENDER WINS, so the rule governing when that result is allowed applies.
quote: RESULT: DEFENDER WINS -- The defender's scriptural chain establishing Christ's conception by the Holy Ghost without human fatherhood stands intact, while the challenger's claim of marital union within the espousal is refuted by the text.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: "A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count": one reading voids the PROP-DEPENDENT standing because its stated reason (link C3 broken) was retracted; the other treats only that collision grade as withdrawn while leaving the standing count.
why: The judge declares DEFENDER WINS, but the only stated reason for non-self-supported standing is a CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade that the same text retracts, so under the rule that standing does not count and no valid condition for HELD is shown.
